alt: A short film with no voice, with music. An entryway with a tall mirror in the middle. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes walks to the mirror, tilts and looks up, and its eyes turn happy. It starts to leave to the left, stops with wide eyes, and walks back for another look. It does it a third time. At the end it narrows its eyes at the camera. The text stays: me taking one last look in the mirror.
